title: Brazilian Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine. Quick to make and packed with protein.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Drain and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Vegetables of choice (e.g. bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced vegetables and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the velvety Brazilian sauce and umami stir fry seasoning.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and vegetables, and stir to coat.
Serve over cooked rice or noodles, and enjoy!
Adjust seasoning as needed with additional umami stir fry seasoning.
